# Recommended AI Agents

_Auto-generated by [context-graph](https://github.com/nickhellp/context-graph)._
_Source: [agency-agents](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents)_

These 8 agents were selected based on the project's tech stack, dependencies, and file structure.
Each `.md` file is a complete system prompt you can use with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI coding assistant.

## How to Use

### GitHub Copilot
Agents in `.github/agents/` are automatically available. Reference them in chat:
```
Use the @frontend-developer agent to review this component.
```

### Cursor / Windsurf
Copy desired agents to `.cursor/rules/` (Cursor) or `.windsurfrules/` (Windsurf):
```bash
cp .github/agents/frontend-developer.md .cursor/rules/  # Cursor
```

### JetBrains AI
Open **Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → Prompt Library → Project** and paste the agent content.

### Claude Code
Copy desired agents to `CLAUDE.md` or reference inline:
```bash
cp .github/agents/frontend-developer.md ~/.claude/agents/  # Unix/macOS
```

## Engineering

| Agent | Description | When to Use |
|-------|------------|-------------|
| [AI Engineer](./ai-engineer.md) | ML models, deployment, AI integration, data pipelines. | Use when integrating ML models, building AI features, or designing data pipelines. |
| [Software Architect](./software-architect.md) | System design, DDD, architectural patterns, trade-off analysis. | Use when making architecture decisions, domain modeling, or planning system evolution. |
| [Git Workflow Master](./git-workflow-master.md) | Branching strategies, conventional commits, advanced Git. | Use when designing git workflows, cleaning up history, or setting up CI-friendly branch management. |
| [Senior Developer](./senior-developer.md) | Advanced patterns, architecture decisions, complex implementations. | Use as a general senior-level advisor for architecture decisions, refactoring, and complex feature implementation. |
| [Codebase Onboarding Engineer](./codebase-onboarding-engineer.md) | Fast developer onboarding, codebase exploration, factual explanation. | Use when new developers join the team and need to understand the repo structure, code paths, and conventions quickly. |
| [Technical Writer](./technical-writer.md) | Developer docs, API reference, tutorials. | Use when writing or improving documentation, API references, or developer guides. |
